name: Trajectories of Physics
description: In an increasingly specialized scientific landscape where boundaries between disciplines blur, the challenge for future generations of physicists is not only studying the universe, but finding their own place within it. CISF27 was created to bridge the gap between lecture halls and boundless career opportunities. Over the conference week, AISF offers a compass to those seeking orientation by exploring physics beyond academia. Through four pillars — History, Energy, Research, and Innovation — we chart the careers of tomorrow, showing how a physics degree opens paths in infinite directions.
